result.markdown: --- title: >- [embedding.EmbeddingCohere]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Creates an embedding function provider backed by Cohere's embedding models. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_embedding.py#L408-L559){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python embedding.EmbeddingCohere( model="embed-english-v3.0", api_key=None, batch_size=96 ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Implements the [EmbeddingProvider](`raghilda.EmbeddingProvider`) interface. Cohere's embedding models produce different embeddings for queries vs documents to optimize retrieval performance. Use `input_type=EmbedInputType.QUERY` when embedding search queries and `input_type=EmbedInputType.DOCUMENT` (default) when embedding documents for indexing. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [model]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["embed-english-v3.0"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The Cohere embedding model to use. Default is "embed-english-v3.0". [api_key]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The API key for authenticating with Cohere. If None, it will use the CO_API_KEY environment variable if set. [batch_size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[96]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of texts to process in each batch when calling the API. Cohere supports up to 96 texts per request. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#40734f3a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingCohere, EmbedInputType provider = EmbeddingCohere(model="embed-english-v3.0") # Embed documents for indexing doc_embeddings = provider.embed( ["Hello world", "Testing embeddings"], input_type=EmbedInputType.DOCUMENT ) # Embed a query for search query_embedding = provider.embed( ["How do I test embeddings?"], input_type=EmbedInputType.QUERY ) ``` :::
